system.description:
Skill: Intimidation

Exploit Type: Skilled Exploit

When engaging a creature who would become hostile based on a poor interaction, you make them rethink their decision. As a Reaction, when a creature would become hostile during a social encounter, you can give an intimidating look meant to cause hesitation.

Make an intimidation check contested by the targets Wisdom Saving throw. On a failure, they become Demoralized or Shaken and lose their immediate hostility and choose to find another way to resolve the situation. If another creature would become hostile or initiate combat, a creature who hesitated as a result of this exploit does not roll initiative, instead acting last in the initiative.

activities.label: I wouldn’t Do that: Intimidation check
